background: ABN AMRO is a Dutch retail, private and commercial bank, part-owned by the Dutch state since its rescue, funded largely by domestic deposits and lending mainly on Dutch residential mortgages and to Northwest European businesses.
synthesis: The rating picture is solid: AA- from Fitch after the upgrade on 12 May 2026, A from S&P on a positive outlook and A1 from Moody's. Capital is the softer side against EU and Nordic peers, with CET1 of 15.3% below the 16.4% median and leverage of 4.8% under the 5.5% median, though CET1 has risen 1.5 points since 30 Jun 2024. Liquidity is the strength: LCR of 157% is above the 151% median and NSFR of 141% sits in the top quarter. The flagged news is mostly earnings beats, with one anti-money-laundering shortcomings item on 10 Jul 2026 worth noting.
